story.title: Sweet Words
story.text: He smiled and said one kind thing after another.
story.narration: In the Tang dynasty there was a man named Li Yifu. Whenever he spoke to people he smiled, and his voice was warm and gentle, so everyone felt he meant well. Every sentence he said put people at ease.

story.title: His Hands Give Him Away
story.text: But his eyes, his cuff and his fingers gave him away again and again.
story.narration: However kind the words were, his body was talking too: his eyes drifted to the side, his cuff tightened a little, his fingers tapped the table. Anyone watching those little movements knew that what he wanted was not what he was saying.

keyMoment.question: He keeps saying kind things. How do you find out what he really wants?

options.hint: Words are easy to say for other people; movements are hard to fake all the way.
He will only give you more of the same sweet words.

keyMoment.reveal: Read the sweet words together with his movements, and you can see what he is really after.

misconceptions: Anyone who smiles nicely must be kind
Sweet words can always be trusted
You can understand a person just by listening to them

quiz.question: What was hiding behind Li Yifu's smile?
quiz.explanation: His kind words only made people relax — his plan was hidden behind them, so you had to watch what his body was doing.

quiz.question: Someone praises your toy and reaches for it at the same time. What do you look at first?
quiz.explanation: Praise is easy to say; where the hand is reaching shows what he really means to do. Watch the hand first, then decide.
